title: i gave Ghorvak a whole quest. the hammer is still a maybe.
author: Equivalent-Honey5812
selftext:
Mistwell Village starts you at the well with a rusty sword. Hunt bosses with an ally, trade loot, then settle things in the Proving Ring.



I made it by talking with Savi, Spawn's AI companion. I started with a village and kept pushing beyond its fence. I decided Ghorvak needed his own quest and a very rare hammer drop, then asked for the hammer to turn the ground to snow. I also kept sending things back when the enemies moved goofy or the land beyond the village felt empty.



free, play it in your browser: [https://www.spawn.co/@jookie75/mistwell-village](https://www.spawn.co/@jookie75/mistwell-village)
